_meta.purpose: Hand-labelled regression set for Muraqib's assessment engine.
_meta.labelling_note: Expected statuses were assigned by reading the declared evidence against the control's assessment question. Cases with no declared evidence are labelled not_assessable on purpose - abstention is the correct behaviour, and measuring it stops the engine drifting toward confident guessing.
_meta.how_to_extend: Add a case with a platform config, a control id and the status a careful human reviewer would assign. Keep the ratio of not_assessable and non_compliant cases high; over-claiming is the failure mode that matters.
